## Pull request checklist

- [ ] Scope is focused and the description explains the change.
- [ ] Relevant tests or documentation checks were run (`uv run --all-extras pre-commit run --all-files`, `make test`).
- [ ] No secrets, generated noise, or unrelated changes are included.
- [ ] Follow-up work is linked to the relevant entry in [`docs/OPEN_PROBLEMS.md`](https://github.com/T-Py-T/ants-strategy-agent/blob/main/docs/OPEN_PROBLEMS.md).

See [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/T-Py-T/ants-strategy-agent/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) for setup and validation details.
